channels:
  - conda-forge
  - bioconda
dependencies:
  - pip=25.3
  - python=3.11.13
  - tifffile=2025.6.11
  - conda-forge::ome-types=0.6.1
  - scikit-image=0.25.2
  - pandas=2.2.2
  - conda-forge::matplotlib=3.10.8
  - conda-forge::imagecodecs=2026.3.6
  - lxml=6.0.2
  - pip:
      - itk-elastix==0.23.0
      - openslide-python==1.4.2
      - openslide-bin==4.0.0.8
      - rami2d==1.0.1

// Copyright (c) the nf-core community under an open-source MIT license.
// See https://github.com/nf-core/modules for full license, file patching instructions and upstream contributing.

process RAMI2D_TRANSFORM {
    tag "$meta.id"
    label 'process_single'

    conda "${moduleDir}/environment.yml"
    container "${ workflow.containerEngine == 'singularity' && !task.ext.singularity_pull_docker_container ?
        'https://community-cr-prod.seqera.io/docker/registry/v2/blobs/sha256/cd/cde38bd19f190e920f5f99178fd6802f841e5e52f596e2efe13f95c733637850/data':
        'community.wave.seqera.io/library/pip_python_tifffile_ome-types_pruned:d3b5c8c723a6348d' }"

    input:
    tuple val(meta), path(image_file), path(transform_dir)
    tuple val(meta2), path(markers)
    val(mpp)

    output:
    tuple val(meta), path("${prefix}/*transformed.ome.tif"), emit: transformed_image
    tuple val("${task.process}"), val('rami2d'), eval('rami2d-transform -v | sed "s/rami2d-transform //"'), emit: versions_rami2d, topic: versions

    when:
    task.ext.when == null || task.ext.when

    script:
    def args = task.ext.args ?: ''
    prefix = task.ext.prefix ?: "${meta.id}"
    def markers_arg = markers ? "-m ${markers}" : ""

    """
    export MPLCONFIGDIR=./matplotlib_cache
    export XDG_CACHE_HOME=./.cache
    export FONTCONFIG_PATH=./.cache/fontconfig

    mkdir -p $prefix

    rami2d-transform \\
        -i $image_file \\
        -mpp $mpp \\
        -tdir $transform_dir \\
        -o $prefix \\
        $markers_arg \\
        $args
    """

    stub:
    prefix = task.ext.prefix ?: "${meta.id}"

    """
    mkdir -p $prefix
    touch ${prefix}/${image_file.baseName}_transformed.ome.tif
    """
}

---
name: "nf-core/rami2d/transform"
description: "Applies transformations to images using RAMI2D, designed to take the\
  \ transformation maps produced by rami2d-register"
keywords:
- "imaging"
- "spatialomics"
- "multiplexed"
- "registration"
- "transform"
tools:
- rami2d:
    description: "Robust Alignment of Multichannel Images in 2D"
    homepage: "https://pypi.org/project/rami2d/"
    documentation: "https://github.com/VictorDidier/RAMI2D"
    tool_dev_url: "https://github.com/VictorDidier/RAMI2D"
    licence:
    - "BSD-3-Clause"
    identifier: ""
input:
- - meta:
      type: "map"
      description: "Groovy Map containing sample information\ne.g. `[ id:'sample1'\
        \ ]`\n"
  - image_file:
      type: "file"
      description: "Absolute path to the input image file"
      pattern: "*.{tif}"
      ontologies: []
  - transform_dir:
      type: "directory"
      description: "Directory containing the transformation matrices/files generated\
        \ by rami2d-register"
- - meta2:
      type: "map"
      description: "Groovy Map containing sample information for the markers file\n"
  - markers:
      type: "file"
      description: "Optional CSV file with a column named marker_name containing the\
        \ names of the channels"
      pattern: "*.csv"
      ontologies:
      - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_3752"
- mpp:
    type: "float"
    description: "Pixel size of the image in microns (microns per pixel)"
output:
  transformed_image:
  - - meta:
        type: "map"
        description: "Groovy Map containing sample information\ne.g. `[ id:'sample1'\
          \ ]`\n"
    - ${prefix}/*transformed.ome.tif:
        type: "file"
        description: "Transformed output image in OME TIFF format"
        pattern: "*.ome.tif"
        ontologies: []
  versions_rami2d:
  - - ${task.process}:
        type: "string"
        description: "Name of the task process"
    - rami2d:
        type: "string"
        description: "Name of the tool"
    - rami2d-transform -v | sed "s/rami2d-transform //":
        type: "eval"
        description: "The expression to obtain the version of the tool"
topics:
  versions:
  - - ${task.process}:
        type: "string"
        description: "Name of the task process"
    - rami2d:
        type: "string"
        description: "Name of the tool"
    - rami2d-transform -v | sed "s/rami2d-transform //":
        type: "eval"
        description: "The expression to obtain the version of the tool"
authors:
- "@kubranarci"
maintainers:
- "@kubranarci"
version: "0.0.0-6d1763b"
license: "MIT License"
